ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when BLOBBASEFEE is called on a chain without EIP-4844 enabled or before the fork activation.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume BLOBBASEFEE is an invalid opcode on chains/blocks without EIP-4844, causing execution to revert with invalid opcode error.

ambiguities.text: The reference to 'get_blob_gasprice(header)' assumes familiarity with EIP-4844 but doesn't specify behavior if blob gas fields are missing.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the opcode is only valid after EIP-4844 activation when blob gas fields are guaranteed present in headers.

implicit_assumptions.description: EIP-4844 is active and blob gas price is available in the block header before BLOBBASEFEE can be used.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts calling BLOBBASEFEE on pre-4844 blocks would fail or return undefined values.

implicit_assumptions.description: The blob base fee value in the header accurately reflects the actual blob gas market conditions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If blob base fee can be manipulated, rollup contracts may under/over-charge users for data availability.

implicit_assumptions.description: The 2 gas cost is sufficient to prevent spam while remaining affordable for legitimate use cases.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If cost is too low, BLOBBASEFEE could be used in gas-cost attacks; if too high, it limits utility for cost tracking.
